name: Hannah Sayre

events.title: Legatee in father's will
events.description: Named in Daniel Sayre's will as 'Hannah Topping the wife of Mr Josiah Topping'.

bioAdditions: Her father Daniel Sayre's will of 1707 (Banta, S1) names her as wife of Josiah Topping; Banta lists only two children, Josiah and John (b. 1706). Not an ancestor of John and, the Sayre line being non-ancestral, not a blood relative.

sources.citation: T. M. Banta, Sayre Family (1901) (archive.org full text), p. 30
sources.supports: Daniel Sayre will naming Hannah Topping; her children

researchLogEntry: Round 4: Banta confirms Hannah as daughter of Daniel Sayre; children Josiah and John only.
